content.title: When and where to watch FC Barcelona v Sevilla
content.text: Football is back again this Sunday. After the last-gasp draw in Newcastle and four days ahead of the return leg at Spotify Camp Nou, it's back to La Liga for a game at home to Sevilla. It's a 4.15pm local time start and this guide should help you work out when that is where you are. If you are unable to watch for whatever reason, or you wish to complement your viewing with second screen info, don’t forget we have full coverage of the game, including the build-up live from the stadium and post-match reactions in our Match Center right here on the official website.
